clash:
# mihomo / clash-meta subscription for alice
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: false
mode: rule
log-level: info

proxies:
  - name: node-1
    type: ss
    server: 127.0.0.1
    port: 8443
    cipher: aes-128-gcm
    password: alice-password
    udp: true

proxy-groups:
  - name: 节点选择
    type: select
    proxies:
      - 自动选择
      - DIRECT
      - node-1
  - name: 自动选择
    type: url-test
    url: http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
    proxies:
      - node-1

rules:
  - GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
  - MATCH,节点选择
